mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Use MBSE/Arcadia/Capella with Agile methods to manage dynamic requirements, interdisciplinary/distributed collaboration, traceability, documentation overhead, subsystem integration, and accelerated preliminary design for a 1U CubeSat.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_abstraction: System-level satellite plus ground/user/mission operations context. Capella operational, system, logical, and physical architectures model major satellite subsystems and actors. The logical layer deliberately abstracts away technology choices; the physical layer maps functions to hardware/software components and interfaces.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: The paper does not present a minimal-knowledge modeling theory. It derives requirements from stakeholder needs, mission concept, KiboCUBE/JAXA constraints, manufacturer technical data, and subsystem team expertise. Behavior is represented with ConOps, operational modes, logical functions, functional exchanges, and subsystem analyses.
generality_reuse_mechanism: specific-mission model with reusable method only

key_evidence.quote: models that contain requirements, architecture, and interfaces between the different parts of the system
The two main analyses in the mission are the logical and physical architectures
Requirements were established initially from mission concept, translated into Capella, and linked to various model elements

generality_reuse_mechanism_v1_1_reasonin.rationale: The paper is a 3ColStar-specific case study. Its reusable contribution is the Arcadia/Capella plus Agile workflow and guidance, not a reusable mission-agnostic model, template, library, open package, or reference architecture. High-level/logical abstraction and interface modeling are present, but the paper does not demonstrate those model features as reusable beyond this mission.

evidence.quote: This paper presents a case study on integrating Agile Systems Engineering methodologies in the preliminary design phase of satellite systems, focusing on the 3ColStar satellite mission.
This case study highlights the effectiveness of Agile Systems Engineering principles ... providing valuable insights for future missions.

implementation_pathway_tailoring.tailoring_notes: Sequential development was chosen for preliminary design validation/risk mitigation; Agile sprints/backlogs were added to handle dynamic requirements and distributed subsystem work.

toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_architecture_and_data_flow: Capella is the central system model for requirements, logical/physical architecture, interfaces, traceability and governance. Requirements are imported/structured in Capella and linked to functions/components/test cases. External analysis tools (STK, GMAT, MATLAB/Simulink, DRAMA) are used for validation/simulation, but automated data exchange is not described. Weekly meetings and system engineers synchronize model changes manually.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_continuity_evidence: Strong within Capella through bidirectional traceability and logical-to-physical links; limited evidence across external analysis tools.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: Physical architecture links hardware/software subsystem components and interfaces, and test/validation criteria are linked before manufacturing; no flat-sat/HIL or implementation integration evidence.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: Tool names and Capella version are reported; Capella is open-source. Model/data repository is not openly provided and requires permission/email; data availability statement says no new data were created/analyzed.

eps_verification_specific.eps_requirements_representation: EPS requirements/functions include continuous power availability, efficient solar power generation/distribution, and resistance to space environmental conditions. Requirements are linked to logical functions (power generation, storage, distribution) and physical components (solar panels, batteries, PMUs/power controller/distribution).
eps_verification_specific.evidence_verification_integrated_in_mode: Requirements/test cases/validation criteria are reported as linked in Capella at component-to-system level, but detailed EPS-specific verification procedures are not shown. EPS physical architecture and power budgets are integrated as part of the system model and appendices.

ivv_integration_level.rationale: The paper reports Capella trace links from requirements to functions, components, verification test cases, and validation criteria. Therefore the current simulation-in-the-loop coding is overstated.

practical_implementation_pathway.rationale: The paper walks through Arcadia/Capella levels, requirements integration, traceability, subsystem architecture, Agile sprints and governance in a real mission case.

toolchain_fragmentation_interoperability.rationale: Central Capella model and external tools are named, with import/manual update mechanisms; automated interoperability across analysis tools is not evidenced.

lightweight_resource_constrained_tailori.rationale: Tailored for a 1U CubeSat, resource-limited distributed university/agency/industry project, weekly sprints, and accelerated 4-month preliminary design.

governance_project_deliverables_roi.rationale: Dedicated model governance/permissions section and reported schedule/avoided-rework claims.

newspace_agile_distributed_rapid_iterati.rationale: Agile/Scrum subsystem backlogs, weekly sprints, distributed teams and centralized model updates are central.

key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: The paper demonstrates a project-applied system-level Arcadia/Capella model for a 1U CubeSat, with requirements, logical/physical architectures, operational modes, interfaces, and EPS power-budget/electrical architecture. It does not provide a reusable minimal-behavior reference model.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: Claimed outcomes include traceability, consistency, reduced errors/rework, improved communication/integration, 4-month preliminary-design schedule, risk management, and more reliable design. Evidence is mainly single-case and author-reported, with one schedule metric and technical simulations but no comparator.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: The paper describes pre-physical validation through linked test cases/validation criteria, requirements traceability, power/thermal/orbit/link analyses and virtual integration; however, EPS-specific verification procedures and physical/flight validation are absent.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: No comparative study versus a traditional approach due to budget constraints and burden of two teams.
Scope focused on Agile plus V-model integration; comprehensive Spiral Model/other iterative comparisons left for future work.
Thermal analysis is preliminary and needs further detailed design analysis.
Implementation/testing stages are planned rather than reported.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No EPS-specific MBSE outcome evaluation despite substantial EPS power-budget content.
No model package or open repository access for independent replication.
No baseline/counterfactual, independent validation, stakeholder survey, defect/rework counts, or physical/flight evidence for most outcome claims.
Cross-tool interoperability is mostly manual/import-based; automated tool data flow is not reported.

synthesis_consistency.lineage_notes: Mission case is specific to 3ColStar KiboCUBE Colombia and references an internal 2023 KiboCUBE mission application. It follows broader Arcadia/Capella small-satellite MBSE lineage but is not a general CubeSat reference model.
synthesis_consistency.confidence_reason: Complete full-text markdown, clear method/tool/context details and explicit limitations. Main uncertainty is evidentiary strength of broad outcome claims, not extraction coverage.
